skills.name: Heavenly Facet
skills.description: Throw a jade prism that bursts in 4 blocks, healing allies 4 HP and giving enemies glowing and -20% armour for 6 s.

skills.name: Balanced Judgment
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at for holy damage equal to the health-percentage gap between you, minimum 4.

skills.name: Kagura Bell
skills.description: A 5-block area pulses for 5 s, healing allies 1 HP per second and giving undead slowness II.

skills.name: Shide Strike
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at for 6 holy damage, doubled against undead, and apply soulburn for 4 s.

skills.name: Confession Brand
skills.description: Mark a target for 15 s; if it dies, you gain strength I and allies within 8 blocks gain regeneration II for 6 s.

skills.name: Censer Step
skills.description: Dash 6 blocks backward, leaving an incense cloud where you stood that blinds enemies inside for 3 s.

skills.name: Indulgence Coin
skills.description: Throw a gold coin; the creature hit gets weakness II for 6 s and you gain 4 absorption hearts.

skills.name: Tithe Strike
skills.description: For 8 s, each hit heals you 1 HP and has a 20% chance to drop a gold nugget.

skills.name: Sunrise Quiver
skills.description: Your next 3 arrows within 10 s make targets glow and deal +4 holy damage to undead.

skills.name: Beacon Flare
skills.description: Throw a flare that lights a 6-block area for 6 s, giving enemies glowing and allies speed I.

skills.name: Blessed Bread
skills.description: Conjure 3 bread that restore 6 hunger and grant regeneration I and night vision for 30 s.

skills.name: Sanctuary Tent
skills.description: Build a 3x3 wool shelter around you for 10 s that grants regeneration I to anyone inside.

skills.name: Phylactery Ward
skills.description: For 10 s, the first lethal hit leaves you at 4 HP instead and summons 2 vexes for 15 s.

skills.name: Grave Hex
skills.description: Mark a target for 10 s; if it dies, it explodes for 6 damage and wither I in 4 blocks.

skills.name: Withering Spores
skills.description: Throw a spore pod that creates a 4-block cloud for 5 s, applying wither I and poison I.

skills.name: Rotroot Grasp
skills.description: Roots in a 6-block cone give enemies slowness V for 2 s and weakness I for 6 s.

skills.name: Mask of Rule
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, shattering 30% of its armour for 8 s; your summons deal +30% damage to it.

skills.name: Chochin Swarm
skills.description: Summon 3 paper-lantern vexes for 20 s that burst for 3 damage in 2 blocks when they die.

skills.name: Soulflame Rift
skills.description: Open a 4-block rift for 5 s that pulls enemies toward its centre and applies soulburn.

skills.name: Abyssal Gaze
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at with wither II for 6 s and blindness plus darkness for 4 s.

skills.name: Borrowed Face
skills.description: Become invisible for 8 s; your first hit from invisibility deals +6 damage and wither for 4 s.

skills.name: Umbral Knot
skills.description: Throw a void orb; teleport behind the first creature it hits and give it weakness II for 5 s.

skills.name: Cursed Coin
skills.description: Throw a cursed coin; the creature hit gets slowness II and takes +20% damage for 8 s.

skills.name: Usury Pact
skills.description: For 10 s, each kill drops an extra emerald and refunds 20% of your mana.

skills.name: Gravity Snare
skills.description: Throw a void trap; the first creature to step on it levitates for 3 s and takes 4 void damage.

skills.name: Rift Tether
skills.description: For 8 s, your arrows teleport the creature hit 4 blocks toward you.

skills.name: Void Burrow
skills.description: Build a 3x3 obsidian shelter around you that vanishes after 8 s.

skills.name: Rift Hop
skills.description: Dash 8 blocks through creatures, dealing 4 void damage and blindness for 2 s to each one passed.

skills.name: Carrion Beetles
skills.description: Summon 4 silverfish for 20 s whose bites apply poison I for 4 s.

skills.name: Grave Fruit
skills.description: Conjure 3 grave fruits that restore 4 hunger, grant regeneration II for 6 s and cure poison.

skills.name: Binding Fu
skills.description: Throw a paper talisman; the creature hit is stunned for 3 s and takes +25% damage from your summons.

skills.name: Bone Lattice
skills.description: Raise a ring of bone blocks around you for 6 s; enemies touching it get wither I for 4 s.

skills.name: Shepherd's Toll
skills.description: Ring a 6-block pulse that pulls enemies 3 blocks inward and applies soulburn for 4 s.

skills.name: Restless Flock
skills.description: Mark a target for 15 s; if it dies, it releases 3 vexes that fight for you for 15 s.

skills.name: Harvest Swing
skills.description: Slash a 4-block cone, applying bleeding for 6 s and healing you 1 HP per enemy hit.

skills.name: Pale Pursuit
skills.description: For 6 s, each backstab applies wither II for 4 s and grants you speed II for 3 s.

skills.name: Ghoul's Jerky
skills.description: Conjure 3 jerky that restore 6 hunger, grant strength I for 20 s and remove hunger.

skills.name: Marrow Pilfer
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at, stealing one of its positive effects and 2 HP.

skills.name: Ribcage Trap
skills.description: Throw a bone that cages the creature hit in bone blocks for 4 s.

skills.name: Bonehound Pack
skills.description: Summon 2 skeletal wolves for 25 s whose bites apply wither I for 3 s.

skills.name: Styx Fog
skills.description: A 5-block fog lasts 6 s, giving enemies slowness II and your summons regeneration I.

skills.name: Oar Sweep
skills.description: Sweep a 5-block cone, knocking enemies back 4 blocks and applying weakness for 5 s.

skills.name: Bamboo Palisade
skills.description: Raise a bamboo wall 5 blocks wide and 3 tall in front of you for 8 s.

skills.name: Sapjade Bark
skills.description: For 10 s, when hurt you heal 2 HP and the attacker loses 10% armour for 5 s.

skills.name: Kami Swarm
skills.description: Summon 3 spirit bees for 20 s whose stings apply soulburn for 3 s.

skills.name: Mossbound Circle
skills.description: A 5-block circle pulses for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second, doubled on grass.

skills.name: Asp Lunge
skills.description: Dash 5 blocks forward; the first enemy hit gets poison II for 6 s.

skills.name: Nettle Shroud
skills.description: For 8 s, attackers get poison I for 4 s and being hurt makes you invisible for 2 s.

skills.name: Glitter Bait
skills.description: Throw a shiny trinket that pulls mobs within 6 blocks toward it over 3 s.

skills.name: Thieving Talon
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at with slowness II for 4 s and a 30% chance to drop one of its loot items.

skills.name: Bramble Shot
skills.description: Your next arrow roots the target with slowness VI for 3 s and makes it glow for 8 s.

skills.name: Leafen Hide
skills.description: Build a leaf-block hide around you; for 10 s you are invisible and deal +20% ranged damage.

skills.name: Trailblaze
skills.description: Gain speed II for 12 s; each kill during it restores 2 hunger.

skills.name: Wildroot Stew
skills.description: Conjure 2 bowls of stew that restore 8 hunger and grant resistance I for 60 s.

skills.name: Bagua Mirror
skills.description: For 6 s, reflect 50% of damage taken back to the attacker as soulburn damage.

skills.name: Yin-Yang Pulse
skills.description: A 5-block ring deals 4 damage to enemies and heals allies 4 HP.

skills.name: Tail Decoy
skills.description: Summon a fox decoy that draws mobs for 6 s, then bursts in jade shards removing 20% armour in 3 blocks.

skills.name: Glass Needle
skills.description: Throw a jade needle; the creature hit bleeds for 6 s and loses 20% armour.

skills.name: Leaf Disguise
skills.description: For 10 s, mobs ignore you until you attack; that first attack stuns for 2 s.

skills.name: Belly Drum
skills.description: Drum a 5-block cone, knocking enemies back 3 blocks and giving nausea for 4 s.

skills.name: Twin Reflection
skills.description: For 10 s, each arrow fires a mirrored twin at another target within 6 blocks.

skills.name: Fracture Mark
skills.description: Mark a target for 10 s; each arrow hit removes 10% of its armour, up to 50%.

skills.name: Cloud Ascent
skills.description: Leap 8 blocks up and forward and gain slow falling for 6 s.

skills.name: Golden Elixir
skills.description: Conjure 3 jade pills that heal 4 HP and grant resistance I for 15 s.

skills.name: Last Breath
skills.description: Strike the creature you look at: kill it outright if below 30% health, otherwise soulburn it for 4 s.

skills.name: Ring of Severance
skills.description: A 4-block ring strips enemies' positive effects and gives weakness II for 5 s.

skills.name: Haunted Crockery
skills.description: Throw a spectral pot; the creature hit takes 4 damage and nausea for 5 s.

skills.name: Rattling Chains
skills.description: A 5-block area rattles for 5 s, giving enemies slowness III and glowing.

skills.name: Ancestor's Call
skills.description: Your next arrow summons an ancestral ghost (vex) at impact that fights for 15 s.

skills.name: Ancestral Sight
skills.description: For 12 s, all mobs within 24 blocks glow and you gain speed I.

skills.name: Incense Circle
skills.description: Light a 5-block incense area for 6 s that grants allies regeneration I and saturation.

skills.name: Offering Onigiri
skills.description: Conjure 3 rice balls that restore 6 hunger and grant 2 absorption hearts and speed I for 60 s.

skills.name: Calling Card
skills.description: Mark a target for 20 s; if it dies, it drops double loot and you turn invisible for 5 s.

skills.name: Rooftop Vault
skills.description: Kick the creature you look at back 3 blocks and launch yourself 5 blocks up and away.

skills.name: Farshot
skills.description: Your next arrow deals double damage and bleeding for 6 s if it hits from over 20 blocks.

skills.name: Fan of Knives
skills.description: Throw 5 knives in a 6-block cone, each dealing 3 damage and bleeding for 4 s.

skills.name: Sandstorm Veil
skills.description: A 5-block sandstorm lasts 6 s, blinding enemies inside and making you invisible while in it.

skills.name: Desert Dates
skills.description: Conjure 4 dates that restore 3 hunger and grant fire resistance and speed I for 45 s.

skills.name: Lasso Throw
skills.description: Throw a lasso that pulls the creature hit 6 blocks toward you and slows it for 3 s.

skills.name: Quickdraw
skills.description: For 6 s, bows fire instantly at full charge and arrows deal +2 damage.

skills.name: Bindle Bash
skills.description: Throw your bindle; the creature hit is stunned for 2 s and drops a random food item.

skills.name: Lucky Penny
skills.description: For 15 s, each hit has a 15% chance to grant luck and 2 absorption hearts.

skills.name: Lookout Perch
skills.description: Raise a 4-block dirt pillar under you for 10 s; while on it you deal +30% ranged damage.

skills.name: Tracker Hound
skills.description: Summon a wolf for 30 s whose bites apply glowing and slowness I for 5 s.
